newsitem.title: PERU: MRTA threat to attack economic, military targets.
newsitem.headline: MRTA threat to attack economic, military targets.

text.p: The Marxist Tupac Amaru rebel movement plans to attack military and economic targets in response to the storming of the besieged Lima residence, a spokesman said on Tuesday.

"There are economic and military targets that will be attacked," Isaac Velazco, international spokesman for the Tupac Amaru Revolutionary Movement (MRTA), told Reuters in a telephone interview from Hamburg.
Velazco said the MRTA had identified the targets before the crisis began. He did not elaborate.

A Tupac Amaru Revolutionary Movement (MRTA) rebel, who asked not to be identified, also told Reuters from within Peru that the group planned "specific" attacks. The rebel added that Japan, whose ambassador's home was the site of the hostage siege, would not be especially targeted in any reprisals.
"We are not afraid that our comrades have died. The MRTA is not going to die," the rebel said.
Analysts have said, however, the MRTA's hostage-taking was its last attempt to resuscitate a dying movement, estimated to have fewer than 200 armed members.
